title: Buyer Beware!! mit did not work, lightly burned my finger taking tray out from toaster oven
text:
Buyer Beware!! mit did not work, lightly burned my finger taking tray out from toaster oven. Nope. This had one job- to keep my fingers from burning when taking a tray out from oven- and it failed. Oh boy.

Bizarre thing is, I was only taking a tray out from my toaster oven (10 minutes) after using the toaster portion (not even the full oven). The first time, I had grabbed the metal rack (was heating left over pizza), and within seconds of grabbing the rack, I nearly dropped it because my fingers were scorched.

The second time, thinking maybe it was a fluke- I used a non stick tray with food on it that just once again needed to be crisped up using the toaster portion of the toaster oven. Maybe the rack had been much hotter or it was just a weird on off thing. I had my husband try it, and sure enough OUCH! I was almost like not using anything.

This comes with two, and I think they are just too thin. I will continue to make use of them--maybe-- as I plan to double them up and see if that works, otherwise they must be trashed. When they first arrived, I thought I had received just one, as they fit tightly together. I think it would have been better to receive one at double the thickness than 2 and be so thin they are ineffective. It is crazy how ineffective they are. I did lightly burn my hand--well thumb. Had I been using my regular oven at a much higher temp for a much greater duration, it could have been a much much worse burn. Ugh.

Not often I haver to say this, but for safety: Buyer beware.
